blogs.title: Byte‑Level vs Token‑Level LLMs – Why Anchoring on Tokens Still Matters
blogs.description: Explains the historical reliance on sub‑word tokenization in large language models, the challenges it introduces (e.g., noise sensitivity, multilingual inequity), and how Byte Latent Transformer (BLT) sidesteps these issues by operating directly on raw bytes.

blogs.title: Patching Bytes: From Fixed Strides to Entropy‑Based Grouping
blogs.description: Demystifies the concept of ‘patches’, compares static, whitespace, and dynamic entropy‑based patching strategies, and shows how BLT uses next‑byte entropy to decide where to split sequences for efficient compute allocation.

blogs.title: The BLT Architecture Unpacked: Global Latent Transformer + Local Encoders/Decoders
blogs.description: Walks through BLT’s three‑part design—large global transformer on patches, lightweight local encoder that maps bytes to patches, and decoder that reconstructs bytes—highlighting cross‑attention mechanics and how they replace token embeddings.

blogs.title: Scaling Byte‑Level Models: Flop‑Controlled Laws up to 8 Billion Parameters
blogs.description: Summarizes BLT’s scaling experiments, discusses how compute‑optimal training regimes translate to byte‑level models, and compares BPB performance with token‑based Llama 3 at different parameter counts.

blogs.title: Dynamic Patching Wins: How Entropy Guides Compute Allocation
blogs.description: Focuses on the core innovation of entropy patching—using a small byte‑language model to predict next‑byte uncertainty—and explains why this leads to better parameter efficiency and inference savings compared to static patch sizes.

blogs.title: Robustness Reimagined – BLT’s Edge on Noisy Inputs & Character Tasks
blogs.description: Highlights BLT’s superior performance on character‑level evaluation suites such as HellaSwag with noisy prompts, phonology (G2P), CUTE benchmarks, and low‑resource translation tasks, illustrating its deeper byte‐aware understanding.

blogs.title: From Llama 3 into BLT: Accelerating Training via Byte‐ification
blogs.description: Explores the practical method of initializing BLT’s global transformer with frozen weights from a pre–trained Llama 3.1 model, shows speedups in convergence, and discusses potential for converting existing tokenized models into tokenizer‐free versions.

blogs.title: Future Directions – End‑to‑End Patch Learning & Efficient Inference
blogs.description: Speculates on next steps: training patch boundaries jointly with language modeling, enhancing FlexAttention for real‑time inference, and re‑deriving scaling laws specifically for byte‑level transformers.
